content.text:
I fixed the layout regressions, and both visual tests now pass against the existing baselines (desktop and phone, 0 changed). I didn't approve or change any baselines.

Three edits in `site/css/styles.css` had drifted from stock Bootstrap 5.2.3:

1. **`.navbar-expand-lg .navbar-nav`** had `flex-direction: column`, which stacked the nav links vertically and made the navbar taller. I set it back to `row`.
2. **`.px-lg-5`** had `padding-left: 1.5rem` instead of `3rem`. That shifted the left edge of every container on large screens, which is why the whole page layout moved. I set it back to `3rem`.
3. **`.form-control`** had `font-weight: 700` instead of `400`. That made the quantity input text bold, which was the only change on the phone view. I set it back to `400`.

The files are edited but not committed.

STATUS: DONE
